service:
[Unit]
Description=Canonfig follower synchronization

[Service]
Type=oneshot
Environment="PATH=/tmp/Canonfig Test Tools:/usr/local/bin:/usr/bin:/bin"
ExecStart="<test-executable>" "sync" "--apply" "--no-input" "--scheduled"
schedule:
[Unit]
Description=Canonfig follower synchronization schedule

[Timer]
OnCalendar=Mon,Fri *-*-* 23:45:00
Persistent=true
Unit=canonfig-sync.service

[Install]
WantedBy=timers.target
